mainEntity.name: What types of photography sessions do you offer on this page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Corporate and team headshots, personal and LinkedIn headshots, author and personal-brand portraits, couples and personal portraits, and on-location graduation photography — all across Coventry and Warwickshire.

mainEntity.name: Are corporate headshots photographed at my workplace or in a studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most corporate headshots are photographed on-site at your premises, where I set up lighting for a consistent look across the team. Individual headshots can also be photographed in a small Coventry studio setup.

mainEntity.name: Can personal portraits and couples portraits be done on location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Personal and couples portraits are usually photographed on location or studio-style. On-location sessions normally suit a 2-hour booking to allow for travel, setup and a relaxed flow.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer graduation photography in Coventry and Warwickshire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — graduation portraits are photographed on location, including around Warwick University and Coventry University, and can include family groupings and campus shots where appropriate.

A 1-hour session (£150) suits a single individual headshot. 2 hours (£275) suits more setups or scenarios such as personal brand, author, couples or graduation. 3 hours (£425) suits larger shoots or multiple people. If you’re unsure, start with a free consultation.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a free consultation before booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — a free 20-minute Zoom or phone call to discuss what the images are for, who’s being photographed, the best location and whether 1, 2 or 3 hours is the right fit, so you book the right session first time.

mainEntity.name: How much travel is included and what are the travel charges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel is included within 15 miles of CV4. Beyond that, travel is charged at £1 per mile, invoiced separately.

mainEntity.name: What file format are the final images supplied in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final edited images are supplied as high-resolution JPG files, ready for use on websites, LinkedIn, print and marketing.

mainEntity.name: How are the images delivered and what is the turnaround time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Images are delivered by WeTransfer or on USB. A contact sheet of low-resolution images is sent first for approval; once you’ve signed off, the final high-resolution JPGs are sent. Turnaround is normally within 24 hours for a 1-hour shoot and within 48 hours for 2+ hour shoots.

mainEntity.name: What is the best way to get started if I’m not sure what I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with the free 20-minute consultation and I’ll advise on the best session type, location and duration. Please note: arriving more than 20 minutes late means the session is forfeited; sessions can be rescheduled up to 72 hours beforehand; bookings are non-refundable.

mainEntity.name: Can you photograph our whole team, and how does booking and payment work for corporate shoots?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — corporate team headshots for 5–50 people are photographed on-site with one consistent look. Start with a free consultation to confirm setup, timing and location. For corporate shoots a 50% deposit reserves the date and time, with the remaining 50% payable on completion — after you’ve approved the contact-sheet thumbnails and before the full high-resolution images are released.
